name: mogoj
description: Automatic, private Codex memory with bounded, cited recall

interface.longDescription: Give Codex automatic, private project memory. Mogoj recalls only relevant source-cited excerpts within strict context budgets and saves conservative Markdown checkpoints after meaningful work. Everything stays local by default, requires no account or API key, and remains inspectable and editable by the user.
defaultPrompt: Recall our latest decision about this project.
Save this decision to my local Mogoj memory.
Check whether my Mogoj memory is healthy.
